tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Read the display name and shipping address of the current demo account. Use when the user asks to see their profile or current address. Do NOT use to change the profile (use update_profile) or to read another account.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Request a change to display_name or shipping_address of the current demo account. The tool does NOT write immediately: it returns needs_confirmation and the UI asks the user to approve. If the new value is missing, ask with clarify first. Only these two fields are supported — for email/password or other fields, tell the user it is not supported; do not call this tool. Do NOT use to view the profile (use get_my_profile).

new_value.description: The exact new value the user gave. Never guess it.

tools.name: preview_order
tools.description: Calculate and save a demo order preview (product, quantity, address, total in VND, demo_cod). Does NOT create an order. Use when the user asks for a price or wants to order something — always preview before place_order. Do NOT use to check an existing order (use get_order_status).

product_id.description: Product code exactly as the user gave it, e.g. 'DEMO-NOTEBOOK'. If missing, ask with clarify.

shipping_address.description: Leave empty to use the profile address; only set if the user gives a different address.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Request to create a demo order from a valid preview_id returned by preview_order. The tool does NOT write immediately: it returns needs_confirmation and the UI asks the user to approve. Do NOT call without a preview_id from a previous preview_order result; never invent products or prices. No real payment.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Read the details and status of one demo order of the current account by order_id. Use when the user asks about an order's status. Do NOT use to create, change or cancel orders. If no order_id is given, ask with clarify.

order_id.description: Order id exactly as the user gave it, e.g. 'DEMO-...'.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Request to cancel a pending demo order of the current account. The tool does NOT cancel immediately: it returns needs_confirmation and the UI asks the user to approve. Cannot cancel shipped orders or other users' orders. If no order_id is given, ask with clarify.

order_id.description: Order id to cancel, exactly as the user gave it.
